summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of FlowFix Plumbing landing page. All major functionality working correctly including navigation, forms, responsive design, and user interactions.

integration_issues.issue: Success toast/message not clearly visible after form submission, though form functionality works

passed_tests: Header navigation links work (Services, Pricing, About, Contact)
Hero section CTAs - Get Free Estimate and Call Now buttons clickable
Mobile menu opens and closes properly
Services section displays 6 services with icons plus emergency card
Emergency plumbing card with Call Emergency Line button works
Pricing section shows 3 pricing cards with €49, €89, €75 starting prices
Why Choose Us section with 5 bullet points present
3 testimonial cards with star ratings display correctly
About section with Brussels image and stats (15+, 5000+, 24/7)
Contact form - all fields work (Name, Phone, Email, Service dropdown, Message)
Service dropdown in contact form works with all 8 options
Contact info panel displays phone, email, address, hours correctly
CTA Banner with Call Now button functional
Footer with logo, quick links, services, contact info, social icons
Floating call button visible and clickable
All sections have proper data-testid attributes
Responsive design works on desktop, tablet, and mobile
Navigation smooth scrolling to sections works
All CTA buttons are clickable and properly linked
